messages:
leo: heads-up: DeployBot tripped an alert for eu-west1 after last rollout — sudden p50 jump and a few 5xx. tagging @ops_lead @nina for quick call.

nina: saw it too, pulling traces. Can we hot-pin to previous image or do a rollback? Which is faster?

ops_lead: pin is fastest, minimal traffic movement. rollback is heavier. Need decision within 10m since the canary window is failing.

deploybot: Canary status -> failures=4, p50=390ms, error-rate=0.8%. Actionable ops: `pin` or `rollback`. Use `/deploy fast-approve` to proceed.

leo: suggestion: pin region eu-west1 to `redwood/serve:2026.03.12` which had stable telemetry. If pin works, we'll keep prod routes and then investigate infra kernel bump.

nina: quick sanity check on release artifacts — nothing wrong at model layer. QA saw no semantic diffs. Likely infra/kernel change. My +1 for pin.

ops_lead: executing pin now:
`/deploy pin --region eu-west1 --image redwood/serve:2026.03.12 --owner ops_lead --note "expedite pin due to p50 regression post-kernel-upgrade"`

releasebot: Pin accepted. Starting controlled pin across eu-west1. Expected duration ~3m. Notify: #eng-oncall, release owners.

infra: added context: kernel team pushed 5.10.82 to edge hosts earlier today. We saw a tokenization syscall latency increase in staging. Filing INFRA-4329.

qa: will run a quick 5-minute smoke against the pinned pool and post results.

ops_lead: pin completed on 10/10 nodes. Health checks green. Telemetry: p50 back to ~baseline within 2 minutes. Error-rate dropped to 0.12%.

leo: great. Nina — can you update release notes to reflect this partial revert? We prefer a short entry: "Reverted kernel bump in eu-west1 causing latency; investigating." Also add a follow-up action item.

nina: on it. Pushing a docs patch now and linking PR here. PR -> https://git.internal/docs/changes/PR-891

infra: INFRA-4329 created with stack traces and repro harness. Kernel team looped in.

leo: thanks everyone. Marking this as expedited approval complete. We'll keep enhanced canary sensitivity for 24h. If any new alerts, reopen thread.

qa: smoke passed. No regressions observed in pinned group.

releasebot: Release note patch merged. Changelog updated.

ops_lead: closing the incident for now. Follow-ups: infra ticket, monitor 2h, update postmortem if needed.
